other_conditions: Must have resided in Delhi for at least five years before the date of application.
Must have a single bank account in Delhi for receiving payment through the Public Financial Management System (PFMS).
Must not be receiving any pension or financial assistance from the Central Government, State Government, other governmental local bodies, or any other source for this purpose.
Applicants may submit the application even if they do not have proof of residence.
benefits_summary: Monthly pension of Rs. 2,000 for ages 60–69, Rs. 2,500 for those over 70, with an additional Rs. 500 for SC/ST/Minority members.
